Nail Revolution

Content & source notes

Verified in the supplied sources

The original Wix website identifies Nail Revolution, founder and head nail technician Leesha Chouhan, the New BEL Road address and phone +91 99861 53243. Its menu image lists nail polish, nail art, extensions, refills and removals. The academy publishes Basic, Advance and Pro curricula.

The accessible Instagram profile is titled “NAIL REVOLUTION | STUDIO | ACADEMY”. Its bio states “Custom Nail Art & Extensions”, “New BEL Road, Bangalore” and “Mani | Pedi | Nail Art | Lashes”. It links to www.nailrevolution.in. This redesign does not claim to replace that site.

Editorial copy and outstanding confirmation

The new headlines and service summaries are editorial rewrites. They are not quotes or independently verified performance claims. Current prices, hours, booking availability, course dates, fees, duration and certification details require owner confirmation. The original claims “#1”, “best”, “top-rated”, five years of experience and international certification are retained in the archive but not asserted in the new marketing copy.

No invented reviews, ratings, staff, awards, hours or offers are used. No stock or AI-generated images are presented as studio work. The booking area opens a call or Instagram; it does not reserve a slot. The enquiry selection only prepares text for copying and sends nothing.

Photography

Photos and the founder portrait come from the supplied brand’s existing Wix pages, reused for this requested private redesign. Their presence on the source site verifies provenance, not copyright ownership. Public reuse and client permissions should be confirmed by the owner. Instagram collaborator photos were not downloaded or republished.

SEO and extraction scope

All 12 pages linked from the homepage were fetched and archived with titles, meta descriptions, social metadata, heading structure, readable text and image references. The services page primarily contains a menu image, transcribed separately. Review text is archived; anonymous testimonials have not been promoted to verified reviews. Video pages have little accessible text; embedded video/audio content was not transcribed.

This private preview is deliberately noindex. Before a public domain migration, confirm content, set final canonical URLs, publish a sitemap, enable indexing and implement the supplied URL mapping. Structured business data uses source-listed details without invented ratings, opening hours or offers.
